name: Justin Gaethje
bio: "The Highlight". Built on the Brawler base with the Brawler's heavy hands and opening KO Rush. Every few seconds he loads up one CTE-style haymaker; if it lands, the opponent is left dizzy, staggering about unable to fight back. The old wrestler in him shoots a double leg now and then for a slam into the cage, sprawls on takedowns and reattacks. Everything he lands looks like it hurts.
